title: Chicago Scav Hunt
includes: Access to the Chicago Scav Hunt on the app
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Take your shot at completing this Chicago Scavenger Hunt around the Loop and River North neighborhoods including the Riverwalk.
Complete this solo or build a ScavSquad of up to 5 people and discover the city like never before!
Use clues and hints within the app to complete the objectives (if you get stuck, you can skip and go back later).
Some objectives have prizes so do your best to complete as many objectives correctly. 
Once complete, you can view the Leaderboard to see how you did against others.
